```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, warning = F, message = F)
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lmerTest)
library(MuMIn)

```


```{r prep data - geographic variation in color, echo = FALSE}

here::i_am("R_scripts/04_Color_correlations.Rmd")


avg_img <- read.csv(here("data/BTBW_whole_specimen_Image_Analysis_measurements_allpop_avgimg_wide.csv"))

## ASY and SY males, with age as a cofactor in the models; the 2 "?SY" birds (age
## unknown) are left out
males <- avg_img %>% 
  filter(Age == "ASY" | Age == "SY") %>% 
  mutate(Age = factor(Age, levels = c("ASY", "SY")))   # ASY = baseline for the Age term

```

# normality checks

```{r normality, echo = F}

# luminance of each patch used in the models (belly excluded, see 01_data_cleaning.R)
vars_to_check <- c("lumMean_c", "lumMean_m", "lumMean_o", "lumMean_t", "lumMean_w", "area_mm2_w")

for (v in vars_to_check) {
  hist(males[[v]], main = v, xlab = v)
}


```


# make a table of results
```{r color model table, echo=F, results="asis"}

# response ~ predictor pairs; color = mean luminance (double-cone catch) of each patch
# belly left out: removed for possible specimen contamination (see 01_data_cleaning.R)
model_specs <- list(
  # association with mantle
  c("lumMean_c", "lumMean_m"), c("lumMean_t", "lumMean_m"), c("lumMean_o", "lumMean_m"),
  c("area_mm2_w", "lumMean_m"),
  # associations with wing spot color
  c("lumMean_c", "lumMean_w"), c("lumMean_o", "lumMean_w"),
  c("lumMean_m", "lumMean_w"), c("lumMean_t", "lumMean_w"),
  # association with wing spot area
  c("lumMean_c", "area_mm2_w"), c("lumMean_o", "area_mm2_w"),
  c("lumMean_m", "area_mm2_w"), c("lumMean_t", "area_mm2_w")
)

# Fit all models and extract results in one pipeline
# response ~ explanatory + Age + (1|Year); Age (SY vs ASY) as a cofactor
results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(model_specs, function(spec) {
  response    <- spec[1]
  explanatory <- spec[2]
  
  # birds with both measurements (so n is the number of birds in the model)
  dat <- males[!is.na(males[[response]]) & !is.na(males[[explanatory]]), ]
  
  fml   <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", explanatory, "+ Age + (1|Year)"))
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(fml, data = dat)
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  
  R2m     <- MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(model)[1]   # marginal R2: explanatory + Age together
  
  data.frame(Response = response, Explanatory = explanatory,
             n = nrow(dat), n_SY = sum(dat$Age == "SY"),
             Estimate = coefs[explanatory, "Estimate"],
             SE = coefs[explanatory, "Std. Error"],
             df = coefs[explanatory, "df"],
             P_value = coefs[explanatory, "Pr(>|t|)"],
             Age_estimate = coefs["AgeSY", "Estimate"],
             Age_SE = coefs["AgeSY", "Std. Error"],
             Age_P_value = coefs["AgeSY", "Pr(>|t|)"],
             R2m = R2m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

# tidy results: numbers kept as numbers, full precision (readable table below)
write.csv(results, file = here("results/Color_lmm_model_results.csv"), row.names = F)

# readable table: rows grouped by explanatory patch, model formula once in a note
source(here("R_scripts/table_helpers.R"))
lmm_table <- results %>%
  transmute(Explanatory = patch_label(Explanatory),
            Response = patch_label(Response),
            `n (SY)` = paste0(n, " (", n_SY, ")"),
            `Estimate (SE)` = fmt_est(Estimate, SE),
            p = fmt_p(P_value),
            `Age estimate (SE)` = fmt_est(Age_estimate, Age_SE),
            `Age p` = fmt_p(Age_P_value),
            `R²m` = fmt_num(R2m))
lmm_note <- paste("Linear mixed models: response ~ explanatory + Age + (1 | collection year).",
                  "Age estimate = SY minus ASY. R²m = marginal R² (explanatory and Age together).",
                  "Luminance = mean double-cone catch of the patch.")

print(knitr::kable(blank_repeats(lmm_table, "Explanatory"), caption = "Associations between plumage patches"))
cat("\n", lmm_note, "\n")

save_table(
  lmm_table %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Explanatory") %>%
    tab_header(title = "Associations between plumage patches") %>%
    tab_spanner("Explanatory patch", columns = c(`Estimate (SE)`, p)) %>%
    tab_spanner("Age", columns = c(`Age estimate (SE)`, `Age p`)) %>%
    cols_label(`Age estimate (SE)` = "Estimate (SE)", `Age p` = "p") %>%
    tab_source_note(lmm_note) %>%
    style_table(),
  "Color_lmm_model_results")

```
